title: Dracula: A Record of the Unquiet Dead

prologue.text: A sequence of journals, letters, telegrams, and records begins with a solicitor travelling east.

scenes.name: The Golden Krone Inn
scenes.setting: Bistritz, Transylvania — evening at the Golden Krone Inn
scenes.openingNarration: By evening I had reached Bistritz, where the innkeeper received me with a warning he would not explain. My road to the Borgo Pass begins here, but the room is full of uneasy glances, hurried prayers, and one name spoken only when the door is shut: Dracula.

resolution.narration: You study the innkeeper's warning and the fear behind it. The road ahead is more dangerous than the map suggests, and the name Dracula is no idle superstition.

actions.label: Prepare for the road to the Borgo Pass

resolution.narration: You check your provisions, secure your papers, and make ready for the mountain road. Whatever waits beyond the pass, you will not meet it carelessly.

actions.label: Ask why the locals fear Dracula

resolution.narration: You ask why the locals fear Dracula. The answer comes in fragments—crossed fingers, averted eyes, and a warning that sounds less like folklore than experience.

actions.label: Take the coach toward the Borgo Pass
